correctness.rationale: PASS: The full zero-matrix Jacobian and equilibrium conditions at any point with nonzero coordinates reduce, by diagonal scaling and translation, each degree-two scalar field to a quadratic in u=x-1,v=y-1. Any 4 of the 6 source exponent columns (1,i,j) have rank 3, so both components share a one-dimensional kernel and are scalar multiples of one quadratic. Enumerating all 15 absent-monomial pairs, each generator has nonnegative discriminant and a real linear factor; therefore an entire real equilibrium line passes through the point, prohibiting isolation. At least five distinct active reactant monomials and hence >=5 channels are necessary. Direct channel summation in the cited five-channel witness gives dx=(x-y)^2,dy=(y-1)^2, with unique equilibrium (1,1) and zero Jacobian. Independently derived exact SymPy 15-case rank and discriminant checks passed; exhaustive structural cases, not all rates or networks. Hypotheses include degree <=2 reactants and full zero Jacobian; products unrestricted.
